Three ways to be on the line

📇 .rents

Free — post & rent

A free profile to rent from anyone and post a couple of your own listings.

  • Rent from any .rent+ or .rent co-op lister with a signed in-app agreement
  • Post up to 2 active listings · 5 photos each
  • Watch listers' videos and live streams
  • Profile picture + "about me"
  • Verified rental history, one checkmark per entry

🏠 .rent+

$9.99 / month — first month free

List what you own and take deposits and payments in the app.

  • Up to 10 active listings across all categories
  • Up to 10 photos per listing
  • Up to 3 videos + Go Live links, shown in the home page video row
  • Messaging + in-app deposits & payments
  • Rental agreements signed and stored in the app

⭐ .rent co-op

Premium — small monthly cost

Everything .rent+ gets, scaled up — plus front-of-line placement.

  • Unlimited listings
  • Up to 20 photos per listing
  • Up to 6 videos + Go Live links; featured videos play in the dial-pad spotlight
  • Commercial account badge, shown first
  • Featured in the dial-pad spotlight

Explore the .rent network

same line, every city

.rent is the company behind every local line — 423.rent, 213.rent, 305.rent, and more. Each city runs its own storefront with its own listings and its own local feel, built on one shared network of verified .rent+ and .rent co-op accounts, so reputation and rentals move with you wherever you go. Browsing without an account? You can view every .rent+ and .rent co-op listing — create a free .rents profile to rent, post listings and build your own verified rental history.
